answer: An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 10 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. The ferrous counter is kept in ember and kernel shows each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that burns. That bill is paid per identity, so 140 aliases cost 189 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
